notes: Coverage is deliberately weighted toward Anna Maria Island and Siesta Key because that is where the 6-8BR houses actually are. Best sources by far were local PM companies: AMI Locals (amilocals.com) publishes a dedicated 7-10 bedroom page with ~20 homes and full bedroom-by-bedroom bed configs and street addresses; Siesta Key Luxury Rental Properties (siestakeyluxuryrentalproperties.com) publishes bed configs, exact lat/lon and real nightly rate bands. Once Upon A Beach (onceuponabeachami.com) and Sato Real Estate also yielded qualifying homes. BLOCKED / FAILED: annamaria.com returned a database error ('The DSN is an empty_string') on every category page; islandvacationproperties.com, thecottagesonthekey.com and resortrentals.us returned 403 / Cloudflare challenges; hometogo.com and booking.com search pages returned 403 or empty; Expedia/Travelocity rate-limited (429). Sato Real Estate's listing subdomain rentals.satorealestate.net did not resolve from this session, so its two entries carry fetch_blocked:true and lack photos and bed detail. Airbnb was not directly fetchable; the two Pinellas entries came through Vrbo listing pages, which DID fetch successfully. REAL COVERAGE GAP: the northern Pinellas barrier islands (Clearwater Beach, Sand Key, Belleair, Indian Shores, Redington, Madeira Beach, Treasure Island, St. Pete Beach, Pass-a-Grille, Tierra Verde) are dominated by condos and 3-4BR houses. Repeated searches across Vrbo, Airbnb, floridarentals.com, Tech Travel and Resort Rentals surfaced almost no genuine 6-8BR single houses there — only the two Indian Rocks Beach homes included here. The most-promoted Tierra Verde 'Waterfront Mansion Estate' (vrbo.com/9132774ha) is listed as 5BR/sleeps 10 and was excluded. Longboat Key and Sarasota bayfront likewise produced no verifiable 6-8BR house. AVAILABILITY: none of these were confirmed for Dec 19-27 2026. Every PM booking calendar is JavaScript-driven and did not render, so all entries are marked 'unknown'. Note Dec 19 2026 is a Saturday, which fits the Saturday-turnover convention on both Anna Maria Island and Siesta Key; the City of Anna Maria enforces a 7-night minimum by ordinance, and AMI PMs commonly require 7 nights over holidays, so an 8-night Sat-to-Sun stay clears the usual rules. PRICING: most PM sites publish no rates at all. Where a number appears in nightly_est/total_est it is drawn from a published range or 90-day average and is explicitly NOT a Christmas-week quote — holiday rates on these islands typically run well above the shoulder-season bands shown.
